notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 3
notes.content: [p]A bit more time has passed, and we've fixed a few more bugs.[/p][p align="start"][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed a placeholder voice line from one of the objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock that prevented progress after playing Bone Poker.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor visual and logical bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you for sending us bug reports. Keep up the good work![/p]

notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[p]We are carefully watching streams of the game and reading your feedback, so here's another hotfix with minor improvements:
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rat minigame was impossible to win[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified the Bee minigame[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues in one of the scenes[/p][/*][/list][p]Continue playing the game to find other issues we have to fix :)[/p]

notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 1
notes.content: [p]It's been almost two days since the release of Antioma. We've been watching streams, playthroughs, and gathering your feedback. So, here's the first small hotfix addressing the issues you've already spotted.[/p][p align="start"][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect dialogue being assigned to the wrong characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues in minigames that could lead to softlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug preventing interaction with certain objects.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This won't be the last hotfix—we're still working on more improvements. Please keep sending your bug reports if you find anything![/p]

notes.title: Antioma Demo — Release Patch
notes.content: [p]Antioma launches in just two days, and we're rolling out a major update to the demo! It now fully represents the final quality of the game, complete with new music, characters' voices, and professional translations.[/p][p align="start"]Help Kiddo escape from the hospital on his Birthday![/p][p align="start"][b]A note for players who are getting the full version:[/b] To avoid potential issues with transferring your save data (we've tested everything, but we can't rule out all risks), we advise you to either:[/p][list][*][p]Wait two days and start fresh with the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]Or start a new game after the full version is out.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]If you're feeling adventurous, you can always try to transfer your save, we did our best to make it work! :)[/p][p align="start"]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added 5 new music tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]All characters now have voices, and the most important cutscenes feature complete voice acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization: All translations have been done manually and now match the languages available in the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]See you on September 10th![/b][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and the first patch for Antioma Demo!
notes.content: [p]We’ve rolled out the first patch for the Antioma demo! In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we’ve polished and expanded the game so returning players can enjoy a bit more content, while newcomers get an even smoother experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]- Added a cutscene at the end of the demo[/p][p]- Added a bit of music[/p][p]- Added localization for 4 more languages[/p][p]- Added credits[/p][p]- Added a dedicated error-reporting option[/p][p]- Added/updated several sound effects[/p][p]- Added achievements (try getting them all!)[/p][p]- Minor fixes[/p][p]The update is already available for download — jump back in and check it out![/p]
